title: Talking Portrait: Dan, age 7, accordion player
content: Here's a new "talking portrait," a video where I combine archival audio with sketchbook art. (Direct link to YouTube video). When my son was just starting out with the accordion, I interviewed him rather formally. Over the next few years, I sketched many of the heroes he talks about at the Irish concerts we attended.----Listen to a free track of the Yanks new album here.
